derivation.fixed_coefficients: For fixed other5field probabilities and couplingtables: b_i=sum_j relation_j*C_ij; a_i weights each assertionrow by the discretebinary review mass aftercoupled scope normalization. S(p)=concern1*(a dot p)/(b dot p).
derivation.affine_constraint: g=concern1*a-S(parent)*b. Because bdotp>0 on the simplex, conserving the parent score is equivalent to gdotp=0.
derivation.kl_projection: Minimize KL(p||target) on simplex intersected with gdotp=0. On positive target support spanning both signs, p_i proportional target_i*exp(-lambda*g_i); derivative of expectedg with respecttolambda is-negativevariance, so bracket/bisection finds the unique finite root.
derivation.boundary_and_support: If zero is attained only on a face, renormalize target mass on that face. Structuralzero target entries stayexcluded; infeasible target support does not mean the fullscore-conserving simplex is infeasible. Same-sign coefficients over the entire simplex contradict parentfeasibility in exact arithmetic and are reported as numerical cancellation, not semantic infeasibility.
